Clara took a deep breath, her heart pounding in rhythm with the ticking clock above. She had spent months perfecting the sequence, but the pressure of the live audience was a weight she had never felt before. As the blades began their descent, she moved with fluid precision, slipping through the gaps with millimeters to spare. The crowd gasped, then erupted into thunderous applause as she emerged unscathed from the contraption. It was a triumph that would echo through the ages, cementing her legacy not just as a magician, but as a master of the impossible.

Regarding the specific detail requested within the narrative context: The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg was the **RMS Titanic**.
